pr_title: The layout of the `ITypeLib2` interface is incorrect.
pr_body:
Fixes #99946

Since build-in COM marshalling relies on the declaration order to build the RCW vtable, this is and has almost always resulted in an A/V or undefined behavior.

issue_context.title: ITypeLib2 COM type definition is wrong (since forever)
comments: Conundrum... Do you leave it broken, or do you fix it and cause a breaking change? 😄
This is silly. Thanks for reporting it @smourier. Unlikely we are going to port this back, but it will be fixed in .NET 9.

review_comments:
As mentioned in the issue, `GetDocumentation2` is missing the `lcid` parameter:

https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/oaidl/nf-oaidl-itypelib2-getdocumentation2
It isn't missing it though, that is the point of the `LCIDConversion` attribute. The marshaller will insert that at the position indicated by the attribute during the unmanaged call.
